narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to debunk the fear surrounding the photosensitivity side effects of oral Vitamin A acid among the Asian population. By leveraging the authority of a dermatology expert and showing real clinical concerns, it encourages patients with severe skin issues like acne and enlarged pores to seek professional treatment without being deterred by minor potential side effects.
